images.title: Four steps for any question
images.purpose: Recap a routine for the mixed chapter practice: read the story, decide HCF or LCM, pick a method, check.
images.composition: Four rounded step boxes in one row joined by three grey arrows, centred vertically, with wide white margins.
exact_structure: Exactly 4 rounded boxes left to right, joined by exactly 3 grey #6B7280 arrows.
Box 1, teal #0072B2: number 1 in a circle and the text Read.
Box 2, amber #E69F00: number 2 in a circle and the text HCF or LCM?
Box 3, reddish purple #CC79A7: number 3 in a circle and the text Pick a method.
Box 4, green #009E73: number 4 in a circle, a tick, and the text Check.
rejection: more or fewer than 4 boxes or a different order
any worked problem or answer shown
images.takeaway: Every chapter question follows the same four steps: read, decide, pick a method, check.
images.description: Four boxes in a row, Read, HCF or LCM?, Pick a method, Check, joined by arrows.
images.context: Shown beside the chapter practice items.
images.teaching_notes: Have students say the step they are on while solving each question.

image_decisions.why: A linear four step routine is a compact recap for a mixed practice set.
